Like many people, Hillary Clinton had thoughts about Monday’s news that the board of Nvidia had reinstated Jensen Huang just weeks after he resigned amid revelations he allegedly had an extramarital affair with a suspected Chinese spy.

And the former first lady didn’t pull any punches.

Instead, she asked a series of questions to point out the seriousness of the scandal:

Is it a national security scandal? Yes.

Is it a corruption scandal? Yes.

Is it an insider trading scandal? Yes.

Is it a market manipulation scandal? Yes.

She finished the post by offering a name for the scandal that snarkily tied it to President Donald Trump’s preferred term for AI: “super intelligence.”

“If it’s ‘super intelligence,’ call it Supergate,” she said in the post.
